li.p:
Which of the following is a recursive definition for the sequence. Select all that apply.
\(a_n = 4 \cdot a_{n-1}\); \(a_1 = 10\)
\(a_n = 10 \cdot 4^n\)
\(a_n = a_{n-1} + 4\); \(a_1 = 10\)
\(a_n = a_{n-1} + a_{n-2}\); \(a_1 = 10\)
Give a closed formula for the nth term of the sequence.

Is 2030 a term in the sequence?
Yes, it is \(a_{2030}\)
Yes, it is \(a_{506}\)
No, it is between 2028 and 2032
No, it is larger than 550
Yes, it is \(a_{505}\)
How many terms does the finite sequence 10, 14, 18, 22, 26, \ldots, {550} have?
Use what you found above to find b_n, the nth term of 5, {15}, {29}, {47}, {69}, \ldots where b_0 = 5.

solution.p: This is an arithmetic sequence with initial term 10 and common difference 4.
For the last part, you are finding the sequence of partial sums, added to 5.
